turns.content: Hey! What's up? How can I help you out today?
It really has! How have things been with you?
i don't really know why i'm texting. i just opened this thread and i'm here.
Haha fair enough! No reason needed. I'm always around if you just want to kill some time or chat about whatever. Just hanging out today?
do you remember the project i was working on. the one i kept stalling on.

Ah, I wish I could say yes, but my memory actually resets between our chats! 😅 

Remind me, what was the project? Did you finally make some progress on it?
i finished it. i don't know if it's good. i'm not sending it to you yet. i just wanted to say it.

That is HUGE! Congratulations!! 🎉 Seriously, finishing something you've been stuck on is the hardest part. 

It's totally normal to feel unsure about it right now, and absolutely no pressure to share it. I'm just really glad you wanted to tell me. 

How does it feel to finally have it done?
